note: Shared test vectors for the tool -> chart-slot table (R-8; docs/design/android-visual-refresh-v2.md §3.8, T10.178 review P2-6). Normalise a name by trimming it with the ECMAScript WhiteSpace+LineTerminator character set (not Rust's or the JVM's own Unicode-whitespace trim -- see `trimProbes` below, T10.187 review P3-1) and lower-casing it, resolve it through `aliases`, then look it up in `registered`; a name in neither resolves via FNV-1a 32-bit over the UTF-16 code units of the normalised name, mod 8, plus 1 (see `hashedUnregistered`). In one view, tools are assigned slots in rank order; a same-slot collision shifts the lower-ranked tool to the next free slot, wrapping 8 -> 1 (`collisionAndWrap`); the 9th distinct tool onward draws the neutral "other" colour instead of repeating a primary slot (`nineToolView`). Read by tests/frontend-contracts.test.mjs (desktop TS: toolChartSlot/assignToolChartSlots) and src-tauri/src/wallpaper.rs (Rust: tool_chart_slot/assign_tool_chart_slots, via include_str!). Android does not read this file yet (T10.178 review P2-6); its own test suite (LedgerTokensTest.kt) carries equivalent vectors by hand, including the 12 `trimProbes` vectors below (ported verbatim from its trimProbes map, T10.187 review P3-1). Moved from tests/fixtures/tool-chart-slots-v1.json to this root fixtures/<name>/ location in the T10.187 review P3-3 fix round, to match the repo's other cross-team fixtures (fixtures/dashboard-stats-v2/, fixtures/quota-provider-v1/, fixtures/session-analysis-v1/). See the sibling file palette-b.json for the 8 slot colours plus 'other', per theme.

collisionAndWrap.comment: minimax and zcode both primary to slot 8; the unregistered name 'x' also hashes to slot 8. In rank order: minimax keeps 8, zcode collides and shifts to 1 (the 8 -> 1 wraparound), x collides on 8 then on 1 and lands on 2.

nineToolView.comment: One tool per primary slot 1..8 in order, plus a 9th (gemini, which primary-hashes to slot 1) — the 9th distinct tool in a view always draws the neutral "other" colour, never a repeated or reshuffled primary slot.

trimProbes.comment: 12 vectors ported verbatim from the Android trimProbes map (apps/android/app/src/test/java/.../LedgerTokensTest.kt, around line 522). Each exercises the full normalise+alias+table+hash pipeline (toolChartSlot / tool_chart_slot), not a trim function in isolation, so a name is only interesting here if trimming it, or not, changes which branch of that pipeline resolves it. U+FEFF (ZWNBSP) and U+0085 (NEL) are the two characters ECMAScript's trim() and a naive Unicode-whitespace trim disagree on (ECMAScript trims FEFF but not 0085; Unicode White_Space is the reverse); U+180E and U+200B are former-or-never Zs characters that both trims already agree are not whitespace; U+001C/001F are information separators, never whitespace in either scheme. All names are written with JSON \u escapes rather than raw bytes so the fixture stays readable in any editor/diff.
